model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different Llama models. The x-axis represents the number of completions (k) on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2^0 to 2^9, with tick labels at regular intervals of 1 on the logarithmic scale, marked at 2^0, 2^1, 2^2, 2^3, 2^4, 2^5, 2^6, 2^7, 2^8, and 2^9. The y-axis represents coverage, on a linear scale, ranging from 0.4 to 0.9, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot displays four lines: Llama-3B (blue, solid, diamond markers) starts at approximately (1, 0.43) and ends at (512, 0.87); Llama-3B + FT (green, solid, triangle markers) starts at approximately (1, 0.47) and ends at (512, 0.92); Llama-1B (light blue, dashed, circle markers) starts at approximately (1, 0.42) and ends at (512, 0.78); and Llama-1B + FT (light green, dashed, square markers) starts at approximately (1, 0.45) and ends at (512, 0.86), with each line showing an overall upward trend.
